meta.description: Curated student cities for TasteAbroad. Tuition and cost of living are rough ranges, not quotes.
meta.costOfLiving: Monthly student budget: shared/student rent + food + local transport.

fx.note: USD values derived from EUR with this fixed rate.

cities.name: Berlin

tuition.label: €0 tuition + ~€350 semester fee (public)
tuition.note: Public universities charge no tuition; the semester fee includes a transit ticket.

cities.source: University fee pages and public student cost-of-living guides

cities.name: Munich

tuition.label: €0–6,000 per semester (TUM charges non-EU students)

cities.source: University fee pages and public student cost-of-living guides
